name: shennong-0.5b
notes: Dimensions mirror Qwen2.5-0.5B (Qwen Team 2024, arXiv:2412.15115) so that the SHENNONG
flagship path is a real CPT of public weights, not a hypothetical architecture.
Qwen2 uses q/k/v projection biases (attention_bias=true); Qwen2.5-0.5B has 494,032,768
parameters in total, of which 398M non-token-embedding (informational; not measured here).
